method: Disposable prefab and original authored clip at exactly 1x speed. Manual Humanoid/Generic clip Playable evaluates at 60Hz; CPU BakeMesh snapshots render the exact evaluated skin. 30fps frames are every second 60Hz sample; optional 60fps PNG originals share the same clock. Loop clips run continuously for two cycles. Finite clips preserve the entire authored duration with short continuous mixer transitions to Idle. No gameplay assets, controllers or runtime scripts are modified. GIF delay quantization is performed separately by the exporter.
neutralStage: Neutral slate background, finite plain floor with 1m reference grid and actual directional shadows where source shaders support them. The preserved unlit character material has an explicitly review-only soft contact ellipse; this is a visual ground reference, not measured lighting or pose correction. No environment kit or gameplay scene.

motions.name: Drink_Candidate_SourceOnly
motions.evaluation: Manual AnimationClipPlayable at source 1x speed; explicit 60Hz samples; CPU BakeMesh snapshot. A fixed parent supplies review yaw/placement; animated root/bone transform curves are never overwritten. Extracted Humanoid root motion is not applied, so authored vertical movement must be baked into the source pose. No per-frame grounding or height correction is fabricated.
motions.notes: Loop and derivative measurements are diagnostic values, not pass/fail standards. Foot slip is reported only for foot-weighted sole vertices within .03m of the floor. Axial positions/rotations and bind-calibrated pitch values are read after exact source evaluation, with a common static stand frame for comparison; they never correct the rendered pose. No healing, damage, VFX or gameplay timing is invented in this source-motion shot.

skeletonReference.method: Read-only reference immediately after Animator.Rebind/Update(0), before any clip evaluation. Exact existing skeleton hierarchy; no invented head-end or pose correction. Stand frame origin is the reference foot-bone midpoint, +Z is static model forward, +Y is world gravity-up, +X is model right. Missing optional bones are explicitly listed; repeated spine roles on a shorter chain are retained with their real paths.
skeletonReference.pitchConvention: Degrees. torsoPitch: hips-to-chest signed forward lean from vertical; lumbarPitch: hips-to-lowerSpine signed forward lean from vertical (positive bends toward model +Z). facePitch: calibrated bind face-forward elevation (positive looks up). *FromBind subtracts the reference angle. faceYaw is signed horizontal deviation from static model forward. All angles are measured, never applied to the actor.
